figurative_meaning_en: Everything is completely ruined or lost
similar_in_english: Up the creek without a paddle
example_sentences_in_bangla: ব্যবসায়ে ইতো নষ্ট স্ততো ভ্রষ্ট হয়ে গেল, কোনো লাভ রইল না।
পরীক্ষায় এমনভাবে ফেল করল যে ইতো নষ্ট স্ততো ভ্রষ্ট।
example_sentences_in_english: The business venture turned out to be a total disaster, everything ruined on all sides.
He failed the exam so badly that it was a complete loss from every angle.
note: This idiom emphasizes complete devastation, often used in contexts of financial or personal ruin, with variants reflecting similar total loss themes in Bengali folklore.
